title: Multi-agent task contract (documentation, not enforcement)
$comment: DESCRIPTIVE ONLY. Nothing loads this file. The authority is validate_task() in engine/policy_engine.py, which hand-checks a subset of what is written here -- approvals.user, for instance, is required below but never inspected there. It lives in docs/ rather than policy/ so that its status is visible from its path: editing it changes no behaviour. Change validate_task() instead, then update this file to match.

conductor.description: Eligibility is computed, not listed here: validate_task() requires the host/backend pair to be a declared conductor-binding candidate whose adapter can dispatch every planned role. Enumerating the pair in this schema too would only drift from bindings.yaml and would still admit invalid cross-products such as codex + claude-frontier.
